declarations.name: AuiBulletChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (measure count, each measure's name, and how many are at or above target).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values and targets in names, the tooltip, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

inputs.name: measures
inputs.description: Rows: { id, label, value: number | null, target?: number, ranges?: number[] }. Ids are unique and non-empty; null, NaN, and infinities are a missing value; target is finite; ranges are up to three strictly ascending finite upper ends (the first range starts at the axis minimum).

inputs.name: rangeLabels
inputs.description: Names of the qualitative ranges in the same order as ranges (up to three, for example ["Poor", "Satisfactory", "Good"]); read in each measure's name, tooltip, and table. Default "Range 1", "Range 2", "Range 3".

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Palette slot of the measure bars.

inputs.name: valueAxis
inputs.description: Fixed domain (max > min; marks are clamped to it) and approximate tick count (2-20). The automatic domain always includes zero and spans every value, target, and range end. label and includeZero are validated but not drawn or used.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Shared chart configuration; a bullet chart never shows a legend (ranges are named in each row's label).

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (Measure, Value, Target, Range): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (value, target, range).

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Shared chart configuration; toggles the aui-chart--patterns host class. Bullet charts draw no textures (one measure color; ranges are neutral shades named in text).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000), divided evenly between rows; the width follows the container.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the value axis, moves labels to the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Shared chart option; validated but has no effect (a bullet chart has no toggleable series).

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; re-renders but has no visible effect on a bullet chart. Emits no event.

accessibility.pattern: SVG bullet chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "bullet chart") of role="img" measure bars with roving focus (Up/Down between rows); data table fallback (native table: Measure, Value, Target, Range).

limitations: Horizontal rows only; all measures share one value axis.
At most three qualitative ranges per measure; the first starts at the axis minimum.
One color for all measure bars; no legend.
A value above the last range end reads as the last range.
The legend, patterns, and hiddenSeries options are accepted (shared chart options) but have no visible effect.
